hub.name: WordPress design
hub.line: Own everything. Fewer plugins than you'd think.

hero.joke: WordPress, minus the forty plugins and the theme that does everything badly.
hero.intro: WordPress website design and development for content-heavy sites that want full ownership. A custom lightweight theme, a short plugin list and an editor your team can use. Fixed quote, 3 to 6 weeks.

items.p: Built for your design and nothing else. No page builder with two hundred options you'll never open.
Post types, categories and templates planned for what you publish, so the hundredth article is as easy as the first.
Every plugin is something to update and something that can break. We pick few, pick well and write down why.
Updates, sensible logins, backups and a host that takes it seriously. We work from our own [website security checklist](/blog/website-security-checklist/).
Caching, image compression and a theme that only loads what the page uses.
The code, the database, the hosting account, the logins. Move it anywhere, hire anyone.

fit.p: WordPress asks for more upkeep than the hosted builders. In return you own everything and can make it do nearly anything. That's a fair trade for some sites and a poor one for others.
yes: Publishing a lot, with several authors
Keen to own the hosting and the code outright
In need of a members' area or an odd feature
Adding a shop to a site that's already on WordPress
fit.no: you'd rather never think about updates. [Webflow](/services/webflow-website-design/) hosts and patches itself. And if the shop is the main event, read the [WooCommerce](/services/woocommerce-website-design/) page first.

items.p: A free call, a content inventory and a fixed quote. If there's an existing site, we look under the bonnet first.
Templates designed in Figma around your real content types.
Theme built, content moved, plugins chosen and configured on a staging site you can click around.
Redirects, backups switched on, an editor walkthrough and every login handed over. Free fixes for 30 days.

price.p: Websites start at $1,299, about AED 4,800, and you can [price yours](/pricing/) item by item, and a site takes 3 to 6 weeks. Hosting is separate and in your name. After launch, updates are yours to do, or ours on a [maintenance plan](/services/website-maintenance/).

faq.q: Do you build custom themes or use a template?
faq.a: Custom, and light. Multipurpose themes ship with code for every feature anyone might want, and your visitors download all of it. Ours only carries what your site uses.

faq.q: Can you fix or speed up my existing WordPress site?
faq.a: Usually. We audit it first and tell you whether it needs a tune-up or a rebuild. Sometimes the honest answer is that the theme is the problem and no plugin will save it.

faq.q: Will I be able to manage it myself?
faq.a: Yes. Writing posts and editing pages is straightforward, and you get a walkthrough. Updates to WordPress and its plugins need a little care, which is what maintenance plans are for.

faq.q: Is WordPress still a good choice?
faq.a: For content-heavy sites and anyone who wants full ownership, yes. For a small brochure site, a hosted builder is less work. [WordPress vs Webflow](/blog/wordpress-vs-webflow/) goes through it honestly.
